featured_reviews.review_text:
The customized passport cover I received was excellent — elegant, beautifully crafted, and high in quality. They also ensured it was delivered before our travel, which I truly appreciate.

Many people noticed the cover during our trip, on our status and reels, enquired about it, and appreciated how premium it looked. We happily recommended TPC Gifts to all of them.

Overall, a great experience and truly worth it!

featured_reviews.name: Somashekar S
featured_reviews.review_text:
I ordered a passport holder from TPC Gifts and I’m really happy with it! It’s a handmade, classy black passport holder that looks very premium. It has space for multiple credit cards, 2 SIM cards, 2 passports, a zip pocket to keep cash safe, and even a place for tickets. Everything is well-organized and easy to access, which makes it perfect for travel.

What I loved most is that they customized it exactly the way I wanted. The design, quality, and finishing are all excellent. The service was also very smooth and friendly. I truly love the product and would definitely recommend TPC Gifts to anyone looking for useful and stylish travel accessories!

featured_reviews.name: kajol singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely in love with this elegant Kajol Singh (KS) handbag! The glossy black finish gives it a premium and timeless look, while the golden detailing and KS logo add the perfect touch of sophistication. The texture is sleek and luxurious — it feels just as good as it looks.
It is same as I imagined
The gold-beaded handles make it stand out beautifully, specially that lion on top of my initials. This bag is spacious enough to carry all my daily essentials without losing shape. Whether for work or a casual outing, this bag effortlessly elevates any outfit.

featured_reviews.name: sumi tauqeer
featured_reviews.review_text:
TPC is not just a brand, it’s an experience. From the way they treat their customers to the care they put into every detail, everything feels genuine and heartfelt. You can truly sense the passion, kindness, and dedication behind the brand. It’s rare to find a team that delivers not just great products, but also warmth and trust. Proud to support a brand that values people and quality so deeply.

featured_reviews.name: rumki GuhaDutta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an amazing time working with Bespoken Gifts. Extremely professional, at the same time very attentive and caring to customers needs and requirements. Bhakti ( the owner) is very hands on and ensures constant communication and quality. She helped me with the welcome gifts for a small family get together that I was hosting in Jaipur. She hand picked all the products as per my instructions and ultimately created a beautiful gift box. All these boxes were very well packed and delivered to Jaipur from Mumbai. She helped with the entire delivery process and ensured that not one piece came damaged!
I am very very happy and impressed with the high level of service and an amazing level of efficiency provided by Bespoken Gift. If you are looking for top quality products, classy gift boxes and a top notch finish with a lovely subtle and not too over the top touch - Bespoken Gift Studio is the place to come to. I am looking forward to working with them again for my next event 💕
